Class StaticSelection

java.lang.Object
application.StaticSelection
public class StaticSelection extends Object
A utility class that provides static references to various application-level data and selections, such as the selected movie, session details, seat selection, products, and customer information. These static fields are used across different parts of the application to store and access important state-related information.
